contract.coMention: Both distinct endpoint mentionIds must exist. The exact contiguous relation.quote must contain both endpoint names (case-sensitive substring after whitespace collapse) and predicateQuote. Co-mention alone is not sufficient.
contract.lexicalGate: predicateQuote must match the type-specific regular expression. Current implements alternatives include realisiert, realisieren, errichtet, errichten, umgesetzt, umsetzen, setzt...um, durchgeführt, durchführen, führt...durch, implements/implement/implemented. Nominal Realisierung and plant den Ausbau are not listed.
contract.nestedEvidence: time.quote must be exact source text inside relation.quote and contain time.text; conditions, when non-null, must occur inside relation.quote. General exact_quotes checks all supporting quotes against the excerpt.
modalityTimeGates: Recognized ab/am/zum/bis/seit/im Jahr/in date-year expressions require non-null quoted time.
A recognized year later than documentDate year (except bis) cannot have asserted modality.
Negation words require negated; checked before condition/future checks.
Conditional words or non-null conditions require conditional and non-null conditions.
Prospective words/phrases require planned or proposed.
Historical words or lowercase standalone betrieb predicate require historical and quoted time.
Otherwise negated is rejected and historical requires time.
contract.otherGates: graph_mentions requires unique local IDs, exact entity quotes with whitespace-equivalent names, and non-person mentions. graph_identifiers requires entity name/value/namespace/issuer together and rejects conflicting IDs within a namespace. These selected examples passed both.
contract.semanticJudge: Direction, actor/endpoint roles, identity, predicate, modality, time and conditions require source-faithfulness judgment after deterministic checks. These three candidates never reached the judge. Unsupported graph claims are critical at judgment; lexical matching alone does not establish roles.
contract.errichtenChange: Current source includes errichten/errichtet and explicitly treats named-builder intent as planned implements, not completed works. No schema relaxation is visible in RelationClaimSchema; these words do not fix any of the three selected failures.
